# Pendexter

## Overview

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Mrs. Pendexter is described as divinely beautiful. Her appearance is striking enough that simply looking at her is considered sufficient, without the need for her to speak.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P42](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0042)_

## History

Pendexter is a friend of [Anne](../character/anne.md) Shirley's aunt and lives in New York, where her husband is a millionaire. She accompanies the famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) on a visit to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). During the visit, she and the other guests are entertained by [Anne](../character/anne.md) with a lovely dinner and a walk through the surrounding woods.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P2](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0002), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P4](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0004), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P5](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0005), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P7](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0007), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P9](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0009), +18 more_

## Relationships

### [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/morgan--pendexter.md)

Mrs. Pendexter is a friend of Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md), and the two women travel and visit together. During a joint visit to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), they are entertained by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/di.md) with a formal dinner and a stroll through the local woods.
